answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 49602 Country: India Title: salam in condition of namaz Question: Suppose if I am offering namaz and someone came from behind and says As'salam Aalaikum and I recognized that voice or I recognized that person and I answered him my mind. Will that affect my namaz? Answer ID: 49602 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 192/160/B=01/1435) If you responded the salam in your heart and did not pronounce the words ‘walaikumussalam’ by tongue, then your salah was valid. But, if you pronounced or spoke it then salah shall be nullified. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
